title: Plato Hydrometer Reading Weekly Sample Day Trend
dataSources: Fermentation gravity/temperature (`brew:fermentation`), kegerator pours (`kegerator:pour`), wine-cellar climate (`winecellar:reading`).
app: Fermentation sensors (Tilt/iSpindel hydrometer, temperature), kegerator flow meters and scales, and wine-cellar climate sensors via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=plato:reading sample_day=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(sample_day) as avg_duration, max(sample_day) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst sample day for Plato hydrometer reading events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture sample_day on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average sample day with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It clearly whether Plato hydrometer reading tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
